limitations: Permit PDF text extraction relations are deferred; condition_anchor_text is limited to DMR_COMMENT_TEXT from structured CSV until C1 permit parsing exists.

No closed-world negation for unlocated limits; unresolved dispositions carry obligation to emit explicit unresolved output rather than inferring absence.
